allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat\(orchestrator\): update to Opus 4.6 model, track .env.example

- Update orchestrator model from claude-opus-4-5-20251101 to claude-opus-4-6
- Read model from ORCHESTRATOR_MODEL env var with fallback
- Remove stale SKELETON comment
- Add per-agent model config to .env.example
- Fix .gitignore to track .env.example \(was caught by .env* glob\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix\(orchestrator\): parser and executor fixes from baseline tests 1-5

Parser fixes:
- Add request_clarification to valid action types
- Add business_logic, architectural to question categories
- Add waiting_human to valid task statuses
- Default file lock action to ''acquire'' when omitted
- Accept locked_by as alias for task_id in file locks
- Handle files[] array format in file locks \(expand to multiple locks\)

Executor fixes:
- Skip self-referencing status updates \(orchestrator updating its own task\)
- Handle truncated UUID matching for self-reference detection

Also adds test script for orchestrator baseline tests \(1-5\).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: question parser accepts nested format \(Bug #4\)

Add tests verifying the parser handles both question formats:
- Simple: { question: "string" }
- Complex: { summary, details, contradictions } coerced to flat string

The fix \(composeQuestionText\) was already in place. These tests
confirm it works for: simple, nested, summary-only, mixed, empty,
and multiple questions in mixed formats.

6 tests, all passing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
